meta.title: AI Product Photos
meta.description: Turn a plain photo of your product into professional marketing images with AI. Pick a format, style and background and generate in seconds. 10 free images, no card.

hero.headline: Professional product photos, generated with AI in seconds.
hero.subheadline: Upload a plain photo of your product and get images ready for your store, your social media and your campaigns. No studio, no photographer, no editing.

steps.heading: How it works
steps.subheading: Three steps. From a casual photo to a marketing image.
steps.step1Body: A phone photo is enough. JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 10 MB.
steps.step2Title: Pick a format, style and background
steps.step2Body: Square for the feed, vertical for stories. Studio, lifestyle, luxury and more.
steps.step3Body: In seconds you get your image in high resolution, ready to publish.

styles.heading: A style for every channel
styles.subheading: Each style changes the lighting, framing and mood of the scene.
styles.studioBody: Even background and controlled, uniform light. The classic for e-commerce and catalogs.
styles.lifestyleBody: The product in a real setting with soft natural light. Shows how it looks day to day.
styles.luxuryBody: Premium editorial look: elegant composition, dramatic light, a magazine feel.
styles.minimalBody: Clean, uncluttered composition with lots of empty space and a restrained palette.
styles.socialBody: Bold, high-contrast framing built to stop the scroll.

free.heading: Try it free, no card
free.body: When you create your account you get 10 free images to try every style and format. No subscription and no payment details.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Square (1:1), portrait (4:5), vertical (9:16) and landscape (16:9). They cover the Instagram feed, stories, Reels and TikTok, web and banners.
faq.q2: Does it work for any product?
faq.a2: It works best with physical products that read clearly in the photo: apparel, accessories, electronics, cosmetics, packaged food, home decor. The better the original photo, the better the result.
faq.q3: Can I use the images commercially?
faq.a3: Yes. The images you generate are yours to use in your store, social media, ads and catalogs.
faq.a4: They are generated in high resolution (2K), ready to publish on web and social without editing.
faq.a5: Each image uses 1 credit and you get 10 free when you create your account. You can generate several images at once in different styles.
